# World of Chips

> Potato chips from 28 countries: the top brands, popular and unusual flavors, snacking culture and where to buy them online, from Japan’s Calbee to Mexico’s Takis.

World of Chips is an independent guide to potato chip culture around the world: leading brands, popular and unique flavors, snacking occasions and where to buy chips from 28 countries, plus buyer's guides and chip news. Some links are Amazon affiliate links (World of Chips earns from qualifying purchases).

## Main

- [World of Chips: Global Chip Map](https://worldofchips.com/): Interactive world map and overview of every country guide.
- [Potato Chip News: New Flavors & Recalls](https://worldofchips.com/news/): Potato chip and crisps news from around the world, updated weekly: new flavor launches, food-safety recalls, industry deals and regional snack trends. Updated 10 Nov 2026.

## Country guides

- [Argentina Chips: Asado & Jamón Serrano Flavors](https://worldofchips.com/argentina/): Leading brands Lay's, Pehuamar, Krachitos, Quento and Pringles; signature flavors Clásicas (Salted), Jamón Serrano, Queso Crema y Cebolla and Ketchup; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [Australian Chips: Smith's, Red Rock Deli & Thins](https://worldofchips.com/australia/): Leading brands Smith's, Red Rock Deli, Thins and Kettle; signature flavors Original, Salt & Vinegar, Chicken and BBQ; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [Brazilian Chips: Ruffles, Churrasco & More](https://worldofchips.com/brazil/): Leading brands Ruffles, Lay's, Pringles, Yoki and Visconti; signature flavors Original, Churrasco, Cebola & Salsa and Creme e Cebola; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [Top Chip Brands in Canada & Ketchup Chips](https://worldofchips.com/canada/): Leading brands Lay's, Old Dutch, Humpty Dumpty and Yum Yum; signature flavors Ketchup, All Dressed and Salt & Vinegar; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [Potato Chips in China: Lay's & Top Flavors](https://worldofchips.com/china/): Leading brands Lay's, Pringles and Oishi; signature flavors Original, Cucumber, Tomato and BBQ; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [Colombian Chips: Margarita, Súper Ricas & More](https://worldofchips.com/colombia/): Leading brands Margarita, Súper Ricas, Yupi, De Todito and Natuchips; signature flavors Natural, Pollo (Chicken), Limón (Lime) and BBQ; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [Egyptian Chips: Chipsy, Tiger & Kebab Flavor](https://worldofchips.com/egypt/): Leading brands Chipsy (Lay's), Tiger, Spuds, Doritos and Pringles; signature flavors Kebab, Shatta & Lemon (Chili & Lemon), Tomato and Salt & Vinegar; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [French Chips: Poulet Rôti, Bret's & Vico](https://worldofchips.com/france/): Leading brands Lay's, Bret's, Vico, Tyrrell's, Doritos and Sibell; signature flavors Nature (Salted), Poulet Rôti, Emmental and Vinaigre; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [German Chips: Currywurst, Paprika & Lorenz](https://worldofchips.com/germany/): Leading brands Lorenz, Funny-Frisch, Chio, Pringles and Lay's; signature flavors Paprika, Salted, Sour Cream and Cheese & Onion; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [Indian Chips: Lay's, Balaji, Haldiram's & Bingo!](https://worldofchips.com/india/): Leading brands Lay's, Balaji, Haldiram's, Bingo! and Uncle Chipps; signature flavors India's Magic Masala, Classic Salted, American Style Cream & Onion and Masala Masti; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [Potato Chips in Indonesia: Brands & Flavors](https://worldofchips.com/indonesia/): Leading brands Chitato, Lay's and Pringles; signature flavors Plain Salt, Spicy Chicken and Beef Barbecue; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [Italian Chips: San Carlo, Pata & Amica Chips](https://worldofchips.com/italy/): Leading brands San Carlo, Pata, Amica Chips and Lay's; signature flavors Classica, Paprika, Pizza and Olive Oil & Rosemary; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [Japanese Chips: Calbee, Koikeya & Top Flavors](https://worldofchips.com/japan/): Leading brands Calbee, Koikeya, Lay's and Pringles; signature flavors Usushio, Consommé and Nori-Shio; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [Mexican Chips: Sabritas, Barcel, Takis & Totis](https://worldofchips.com/mexico/): Leading brands Sabritas (Lay's), Barcel, Takis and Totis; signature flavors Chile & Limón, Salsa Verde, Jalapeño and Adobadas; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.
- [Netherlands Chips: Top Brands & Flavors](https://worldofchips.com/netherlands/): Leading brands Lay's, Croky, Chio, Doritos and Pringles; signature flavors Naturel, Paprika, Bolognese and Cheese Onion; unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.

- [Potato Chips in Nigeria: Brands & Flavors](https://worldofchips.com/nigeria/): Leading brands Pringles, Lay's, Zifort, Greenco and Delicious; signature flavors Original, Sour Cream & Onion, Hot & Spicy and Peppered (plantain); unique flavors, culture, FAQs and where to buy.

- [Buy Takis & Honey Butter Chip in Europe](https://worldofchips.com/where-to-buy-asian-chips-europe/): Which UK supermarkets stock Takis, which EU online shops sell Haitai Honey Butter Chip and at what price, and how to get Japanese and Korean chips delivered in Europe. Checked October 2026.
- [Where to Buy Takis in Sweden, NL & Germany](https://worldofchips.com/where-to-buy-takis-europe/): Shops that stock Takis in Sweden, the Netherlands and Germany: Albert Heijn, Jumbo and PLUS, REWE and EDEKA, and Swedish online candy shops, with prices checked November 2026.
- [Where to Buy Honey Butter Chip in SE, NL & DE](https://worldofchips.com/where-to-buy-honey-butter-chip-europe/): Where to buy Haitai Honey Butter Chip in the Netherlands, Germany and Sweden: Asian grocers and online shops such as Tjin&#8217;s Toko, Nanuko, MAOMAO and K-shop, with prices checked November 2026.
- [International Chip Variety Packs (2026)](https://worldofchips.com/best-international-chip-variety-packs/): Where to buy international-flavor potato chips online in 2026: Amazon exotic chip variety packs vs. subscription snack boxes, verified prices, and how to avoid stale or overpriced bundles.
- [Spicy Chips to Buy Online: 7 Hot Picks (2026)](https://worldofchips.com/spiciest-chips-you-can-buy/): A shopping list, not a heat ranking: seven spicy chips you can order on Amazon.com, from Takis Fuego and Blue Heat (rated Extreme on the Takis Heat-O-Meter) to Pringles Hot Ones Los Calientes and Cape Cod Sweet & Spicy Jalapeño.
- [Best Chip Gift Boxes for Christmas 2026](https://worldofchips.com/best-chip-gift-boxes/): Christmas and holiday chip gift boxes and variety packs on Amazon.com: Broadway Basketeers gift tower, 40-count care package, Frito-Lay and Wise variety packs, Takis 18-bag mix, Australian Red Rock Deli and British Monster Munch.
- [Christmas Chip Gifts 2026: Best Snack Sets](https://worldofchips.com/christmas-chip-gifts-2026/): Christmas 2026 gift guide for chip lovers: international variety packs, Japanese, Korean, British and Mexican chip sets, snack subscription boxes and budget tiers, with comparison tables and why each one makes a good gift.
- [Best Korean Chips to Buy Online (2026)](https://worldofchips.com/best-korean-chips-to-buy-online/): Korean chips you can order on Amazon.com: Haitai Honey Butter Chips, Orion Turtle Chips (sweet corn and choco), Nongshim Shrimp Crackers and Orion Marine Boy, with what each tastes like.
- [Best Mexican Chips: Takis, Sabritas & Barcel](https://worldofchips.com/best-mexican-chips-to-buy-online/): Mexican chips you can order on Amazon.com: Takis Fuego and variety packs, Sabritas Chile Limón, Lay’s Limón and Barcel Chip’s Jalapeño. Chilli, lime and the brands behind them.
- [Best British Crisps to Buy Online (2026)](https://worldofchips.com/best-british-crisps-to-buy-online/): British crisps you can order on Amazon.com: Walkers multipacks, Cheese & Onion and Salt & Shake, Tyrrell’s Sea Salt & Cider Vinegar and Walkers MEGA Monster Munch, with the history behind them.
- [How to Make Potato Chips at Home](https://worldofchips.com/make-chips-at-home/): Everything you need to make potato chips and crisps at home: a step-by-step recipe, plus guides to mandoline slicers, deep fryers, air fryers and chip seasonings.
- [Homemade Crisps Recipe: Fried or Air Fryer](https://worldofchips.com/homemade-crisps-recipe/): A simple homemade potato crisps (chips) recipe: slice thin, rinse, dry, then deep-fry at 180°C or air-fry at 210°C and season while warm. Pin-friendly step-by-step.
- [Best Mandoline Slicers for Chips (2026)](https://worldofchips.com/best-mandoline-slicers-for-chips/): Five well-known mandoline slicers for cutting paper-thin potato slices for homemade chips and crisps, from OXO and Benriner to KitchenAid, plus a pair of cut-resistant gloves.
- [Best Deep Fryers for Chips (2026)](https://worldofchips.com/best-deep-fryers-for-chips/): Five well-known home deep fryers for frying homemade potato chips at a steady 180°C/350°F, from T-fal and Cuisinart to the Presto FryDaddy, with safety tips.
- [Best Air Fryers for Chips (2026)](https://worldofchips.com/best-air-fryers-for-chips/): Five popular air fryers for making lower-oil homemade potato crisps, from Ninja and COSORI to Instant and Philips, with BBC Good Food's air-fryer crisp method.
- [Chip Seasoning Powders for Homemade Crisps](https://worldofchips.com/chip-seasoning-powders/): Six seasonings you can buy to flavour homemade potato chips, including Tajín, Old Bay, ranch seasoning, smoked paprika, salt & vinegar powder and popcorn seasonings, plus when to add them.
- [Spiciest Chips Ranked by Heat](https://worldofchips.com/spiciest-chips/): A heat ranking, not a shopping list: eleven spicy chips ranked by evidence: the pepper each uses, its Scoville range and the maker’s own heat claims, from jalapeño kettle chips through Paqui ghost pepper and Carolina Reaper chips to the discontinued One Chip Challenge.
- [Chip Flavours of the World & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/): One page per classic chip flavour, from prawn cocktail and ketchup to nori, paprika and Flamin' Hot, with sourced origin stories and where to buy them.
- [Limited-Edition Chip Calendar 2026](https://worldofchips.com/limited-edition-chips/): A running calendar of limited-edition and new chip flavours by month and country, from Lay's Holi-LAY'S to KETTLE festive editions and Korean collaborations, each with a source.
- [Halloween Chips 2026: Spooky Flavours](https://worldofchips.com/halloween-chips-2026/): Halloween 2026 chips: Takis Zombie, Wotsits Bag of Bones, Cheetos Sweet Phantom Heat and Bag of Bones, plus limited-edition drops by country. Every item sourced.
- [Quiz: Which Country's Chip Are You?](https://worldofchips.com/which-chip-are-you/): Five quick questions match you to a country's signature chip, from British salt & vinegar to Korean honey butter, then take you to that country's chip guide. Shareable result link.
- [Add Your Local Chip Flavour to Our Map](https://worldofchips.com/submit-a-flavor/): Spotted a local chip flavour we are missing? Send us a photo and a few details. Approved finds appear on the Global Chip Map and the country page, credited to you.
- [The Pringles Index 2026: What a Can of Pringles Costs in 30 Countries](https://worldofchips.com/pringles-index/): A Big Mac Index for chips: the regular price of Pringles Original in 30 countries per 100 g in USD. Turkey is the priciest (about $3.96–4.20 per 100 g); India and France are the cheapest at about $1.08. Sources for every price.
- [Chip Shrinkflation Tracker](https://worldofchips.com/shrinkflation/): A sourced log of chip and crisp packs that got smaller: 11 cases from Lay's, Walkers, Pringles, Doritos and others in the UK, US, Germany and the Netherlands, with old and new sizes.
- [What’s in a Bag of Chips? US, UK, NL & Mexico](https://worldofchips.com/whats-in-a-bag-of-chips/): We read 1,785 chip ingredient lists from Open Food Facts. 44.4% of UK chips list yeast extract but 6.0% list MSG; in the US, 15.1% list MSG.
- [Christmas Snack Box Comparison 2026](https://worldofchips.com/christmas-snack-box-comparison-2026/): Compare international snack boxes to give this Christmas: Universal Yums, Bokksu, TokyoTreat, Sakuraco, MexiCrate, SnackCrate and Daebak. Price tiers, origin, what is inside and shipping, from each company’s own site.
- [About World of Chips: Who Runs the Site](https://worldofchips.com/about/): World of Chips is a guide to potato chips around the world, founded by Michael van der Looij. How we research, source and fund the site.

## Flavour pages

- [Prawn Cocktail Chips: Origins & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/prawn-cocktail/): Prawn cocktail crisps are a sweet, tangy, tomato-and-seafood-sauce flavour and a fixture of British crisp aisles. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy prawn cocktail chips online.
- [Ketchup Chips: Origins & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/ketchup/): Ketchup chips are Canada’s signature flavour: tangy-sweet tomato, sugar and vinegar, closer to “inspired by ketchup” than the real thing. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy ketchup chips online.
- [Salt & Vinegar Chips: Origins & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/salt-and-vinegar/): Salt & vinegar is the sharp, mouth-puckering classic, and in Britain it’s inseparable from fish and chips. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy salt & vinegar chips online.
- [Sour Cream & Onion Chips: Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/sour-cream-and-onion/): Sour cream & onion is creamy, tangy and oniony, and one of the best-selling chip flavours from the US to Scandinavia. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy sour cream & onion chips online.
- [Paprika Chips: Origins & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/paprika/): Paprika chips are mild, sweet-smoky and red-dusted, and continental Europe’s answer to cheese & onion. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy paprika chips online.
- [Nori / Seaweed Chips: Origins & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/nori-seaweed/): Nori chips, Japan’s norishio (seaweed and salt), are savoury and oceanic, with flecks of green laver. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy nori / seaweed chips online.
- [BBQ Chips: Origins & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/bbq/): Barbecue chips are smoky, sweet and savoury, and America’s oldest flavoured chip. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy bbq chips online.
- [Dill Pickle Chips: Origins & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/dill-pickle/): Dill pickle chips are vinegary, garlicky and herby: a North American cult favourite. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy dill pickle chips online.
- [Flamin’ Hot Chips: Origins & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/flamin-hot/): Flamin’ Hot is Frito-Lay’s red-dusted chilli seasoning, used on Cheetos, Lay’s, Ruffles, Doritos and more. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy flamin’ hot chips online.
- [Cheese & Onion Chips: Origins & Where to Buy](https://worldofchips.com/flavors/cheese-and-onion/): Cheese & onion is where flavoured crisps began, and it’s still Britain’s favourite. Sourced history, the countries that love it, and where to buy cheese & onion chips online.
